content.title: China Resources Cement (SEHK:1313) One-Off Loss Challenges Positive Growth Narratives Despite High Valuation
content.summary: China Resources Building Materials Technology Holdings (SEHK:1313) has seen profits drop sharply over the past five years, with net earnings falling by 60.9% annually and margins slipping from 1.4% to just 1% this year. Last year’s results were also hit hard by a one-off loss of CN¥257.5 million, while revenue growth is forecast at only 3.9% per year, slower than the Hong Kong market average of 8.6%. Despite these headwinds, analyst forecasts now call for earnings to surge by 41.8% per year...
